insights: Argument tracking requires an exact definition, local linkage and no escaping function address; observed callers alone do not bound externally supplied arguments.
Return tracking separately requires exact definition and excludes naked assembly functions. Argument and result summaries need different eligibility conditions.

Global tracking checks definitive initializer, local linkage, every use, exact loaded/stored type, non-volatile access and forbids storing the global address itself. The helper excludes constant globals; that is a scope restriction of this helper, not a claim that constants cannot be optimized.
ink_actions: Keep summary applicability bound to the exact source, checked callback captures and complete call graph. Treat public entry-point parameters as unconstrained unless explicit proof premises establish a bound.
Put specialization algorithms and assumptions in database laws; use source-bound summaries only to propose those laws and replay each application.
For maintained state facts preserve every mutating action, rollback and restore boundary. A scalar equality or measured workload does not establish mutation completeness.
